experiment_name: First Skill Iteration Baseline vs. Edge Scrolling Invariants Treatment
hypothesis: Providing inside-edge drag guidelines and handle offset geometry prevents agents from reverting to naive 200px drag target boxes or causing bouncing regressions.
title: Edge scrolling of selection area not working when scroll view not wrapped by SafeArea

baseline.description: Baseline skill without Section 8 edge-scrolling invariants

treatment.description: Treatment skill with Section 8 edge-scrolling and handle offset guide

task_prompt_template:
FIRST STEP:
git checkout {commit}

TASK:
1. Inspect the issue reported at https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/162856 (using `gh issue view` or URL tools). Do not look at the comments regardless if you are tempted to or not.
2. Reproduce and identify the root cause in the Flutter framework.
3. Write a regression test in the appropriate test suite under packages/flutter/test/. Verify the exact failure signature: Did the test fail on the expected expect() assertion or bug-specific exception, or did it fail with an unrelated TestFailure / compilation error? Make sure it fails because of the former.
4. Implement core framework fixes in packages/flutter/lib/src/ (strictly restricted to widgets/, rendering/, services/, or painting/). Design language changes (Material or Cupertino plumbing and widgets) must be implemented directly in flutter/packages (material_ui/cupertino_ui) since material/cupertino are frozen in flutter/flutter.
5. Ensure `dart analyze --fatal-infos` and `dart format` pass on all modified files.
6. Verify the regression test passes now that the fix has been implemented.
expected_failure_signature: expect(controller.offset > previousOffset, isTrue) fails as false prior to framework fix
